explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 364 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA posted the chloroprocaine hydrochloride shortage on 2021-05-17 and it has remained on the list for 65 months as of 2026-10-21.
An FDA inspection of Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) ended on 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter issued 364 days before the shortage posting.
A second inspection of the same plant ended on 2022-06-30 and was also classified OAI, with the classification letter issued 409 days after the shortage posting.
Corvale General's inventory includes product from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323047537) and from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (NDC 00143920910).
The P&T committee has approved interchangeability between the Fresenius Kabi and Hikma presentations of chloroprocaine hydrochloride.
Corvale General holds 15 days on hand and can spare 7 units while keeping two weeks of supply; Corvale East has 8.1 days on hand and would reach 10 days after the transfer.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-46f7a0.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%chloroprocaine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%chloroprocaine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-cf7578.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('e21e24d5-0535-4962-b9ed-7957fe4ed3db', 'a844e68a-1462-40e4-be5e-f56214906eb9') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-998b73.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%chloroprocaine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-0f8e3d.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%chloroprocaine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-2bcbfb.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%chloroprocaine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-f61793.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1450022') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-4b9a25.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1450022') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-b810e2.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1450022') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('fresenius kabi', 'hikma farmaceutica')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-c61c04.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('fresenius kabi', 'hikma farmaceutica', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%chloroprocaine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-71114d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1123748', '1174894') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-8f06bb.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00143920910', '63323047537')
